request.subject: UNIT:MARTIAN:KNIGHT

layers.text: Turn this small saucer into a giant mothership filling the whole width of the image and most of its height: a massive thick chrome hull of three stacked tiers narrowing toward the top, each with its own ring of magenta lights; on top a small chrome command dome with dark windows and two antennas; under it one huge magenta beam port. No pilot, no glass bubble, no legs; empty space under it. Keep the colours, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
